description: PEA retail tariff, keyed by vintage year. Rates verified line by line against the Rofu (Thailand) invoice for 06/2025 (rate code 4224, 22-33 kV): the full bill reconstructs from these values to within 0.01 THB. Ft is billed on total kWh and is revised every four months; the 2025 windows are read directly off the 2025 invoices and the 2026 windows are read off PEA's published Ft surcharge notices.

2025.source: PEA Schedule 4.2 Large General Service TOU, 22-33 kV; verified against Rofu invoice 06/2568 (rate code 4224)

ft_windows.source: PEA Ft surcharge JAN-APR 2026 (pea.co.th); Bangkok Post 'Power price cut to bring in the New Year'; Nation Thailand 'Power tariff cut to 3.88 baht'
